C1067.title: Shanghai Solves a Computer Information System Sabotage Case
C1067.summary: In April 2023, the Jing'an Branch of the Shanghai Public Security Bureau received a report from a Shanghai-based technology company that its unmanned self-service coffee machine communication management system had malfunctioned, causing dozens of the city's unmanned coffee machines to be paralyzed for several days.
